Historical Reconstruction: NVIDIA FY2027 Q3 Preview
This preview is a historical reconstruction. It uses only information from NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release published on August 26, 2026. It was not written before the Q3 FY2027 earnings release.

Basis
In Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA reported revenue of $96.2B. Revenue increased 18% sequentially and 106% year over year. GAAP gross margin was 75.0%. Non-GAAP gross margin was 75.0%. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.46. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.22. Data Center revenue was $89.0B. It increased 18% sequentially and 117% year over year. Edge Computing revenue was $7.2B. It increased 13% sequentially and 27% year over year. NVIDIA returned about $26.0B to shareholders. Remaining repurchase authorization was about $99.0B. The quarterly dividend was $0.25 per share. Since FY2027 Q1, non-GAAP results include stock-based compensation expense.

Guidance
For Q3 FY2027, NVIDIA guided revenue to $108.0B, plus or minus 2%. The guidance assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were guided to 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP operating expenses were guided to about $9.2B. Non-GAAP operating expenses were guided to about $9.0B. The FY2027 tax rate expectation is 16% to 18% for GAAP and non-GAAP, excluding discrete items.

Core questions
First, how will the zero China assumption affect reported revenue? Second, does the gross margin decline from 75.0% to 74.0% reflect the Vera Rubin ramp? Third, can Edge Computing continue to grow after its 13% sequential gain?

Expectation gaps
The revenue midpoint implies about 12% sequential growth. Management cites accelerating demand and multiple frontier labs. The $500B financing partnerships are over time and subject to definitive agreements. They are not current orders. Excluding China Data Center revenue is a negative in the outlook. Lower gross margin is also a negative.

Verification points
Actual revenue should be compared with $108.0B plus or minus 2%. Actual gross margin should be compared with 74.0% plus or minus 50 basis points. Actual operating expenses should be compared with the $9.2B and $9.0B guidance. Data Center and Edge Computing revenue should be reported separately. The company may disclose China Data Center revenue. Shareholder returns and tax rate are additional checks. The source does not include market consensus, so this preview uses no consensus numbers.

毛利率从75.0%降至74.0%是否主要由Vera Rubin量产上量引起？若是，后续季度毛利率能否回升？
Apollo等$5,000亿融资平台尚未签署最终协议，能否将其视为Q3或近期订单需求？
fact_checks: 第一轮核实：日期与季度——来源为2026-08-26发布的Q2 FY2027财报，目标为FY2027 Q3；币种为美元，EPS为美元/股；GAAP与非GAAP口径分别核对；集团与分部——Data Center $89.0B、Edge Computing $7.2B与新闻稿一致；公司指引——营收$108.0B±2%、毛利率74.0%±50bp、营业费用$9.2B/$9.0B、全年税率16%-18%均来自新闻稿；市场共识——来源未提供，故未引用；本稿推论——$108B中点隐含环比约+12%，$105.8B-$110.2B由±2%计算，营业费用增量约$0.8B由上季实际与指引比较得出。第二轮互检：以怀疑的初次读者身份提出三个会改变理解的问题，据此调整正文，确保结论与证据一致。
